editorialDecl.p: Diplomatic transcription of printed pages 593–615. The page image is authoritative; OCR is corrected against it. Greek verse is encoded as numbered TEI lines. Printed orthography and editorial matter are preserved; machine-generated encoding requires review.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Initial page-level extraction using deepseek-flash; prompt dindorf-aeschylus-fragments-hathi-tei-v2-2026-10-08.
Recorded 193 conservative Dindorf–Nauck fragment correspondences from normalized quoted-Greek similarity; unmatched fragments remain unlinked.
Split the aggregate Aeschylus fragment corpus into the play-level CTS work tlg0085.kares; fragment wording was not changed.

div.note: Erfurdtius ad Sophoclis Philoct. 437. p. 223 παντὸς ἀνατρέπων. Poterat hoc facilius πάντ᾽ ἀνατρέπων. Similia de Marte dicta poetarum collegit Valckenarius Diatrib. Eurip. p. 225.

Stephanus Byz., Μύλασα: πόλις Καρίας, ἀπὸ Μυλάσου-λέγεται καὶ Μύλας, ὡς Αἰσχύλος ἐν Καρσὶν ἡ Εὐρώπῃ. Hæc nominis forma fortasse restituenda Machoni apud Athenæum VIII. p. 336 c. ubi nunc Ægyptiæ urbis nomen Μύλωνα in fine trimetri legitur: nisi aut elisionem admisit, aut Μύλων scripsit. Μύλασσα male scribitur ibid. p. 1348 d. Corrige Μύλασα.
